messages:
Elena R: Quick ask — candidate scheduled Wed 11:30-12:00 (SRE IC2). Can we add 5-10m padding before and after for buffer / note-taking? Also need a scribe and confirmation whether we livestream. Candidate requested captions for accessibility.
Priya K: Noted. Which scribe? @Samir P are you available to scribe? I'll mark livestream as optional and confirm consent flow.
Samir P: I can scribe, happy to. 10m padding sounds good. Will capture quick notes in the debrief doc. Can you drop the link?
Elena R: Thanks! Debrief doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folder/xyz — short link. We prefer ASR captions on livestream — @People Ops Bot can you flag consent flow for the candidate?
People Ops Bot: Heads-up: Candidate consent required for livestream/recording. Send them this consent form: https://forms.company/consent. If candidate declines, record internal notes only and do not stream.
Rohan M: Quick rubric q: for SRE IC2, should we weight "operational troubleshooting" higher? The current rubric has it equal with system design. If yes, I'll update the weights.
Priya K: Good point. Proposal: bump ops troubleshooting +5% (20% -> 25%) and reduce 'culture fit' by 5%. Agree @Elena R @Samir P?
Elena R: :thumbsup: Agreed. Please make the edit and ping me after.
Samir P: Done — updated rubric and added a short note under 'timing' to leave a 5m cold-buffer between interviews. I also added a one-paragraph template for quick debrief bullets (strengths, concerns, hire recommendation).
Priya K: Thanks. One operational ask: candidate timezone is UTC-7, interview scheduled in PT. Can someone verify the calendar invite shows the right time? We had a duplicate/shift earlier.
Rohan M: I'll double-check invites and set event timezone explicitly to America/Los_Angeles. Also will remove any duplicate invites.
Elena R: Appreciated. If livestream is on, please start the stream 3m early to verify captions. Samir, I'm assigning the scribe role to you in the calendar invite now.
Samir P: Got it. Will start livestream check at 11:27 PT. If candidate opts out of livestream, I'll open the debrief doc at 12:03 and capture notes locally.
Priya K: :white_check_mark: All set on my end. Ping here if anything changes or if you want me to handle consent follow-up.
